responsibility: This header declares the tree-oriented optab query interface. It defines optab_subtype to distinguish scalar versus vector shift/rotate forms and exports functions that map tree operations and types to optabs, test whether widening/conversion/vector compare/vector conditional operations are target-supported, initialize tree optimization optab state, and query target support for a tree operation on a given type.
same_name_distinction: Declares the tree-specific optabs API, including optab_subtype and functions for mapping tree operations to optabs and checking tree/vector support. Unlike gcc/optabs-tree.cc, it is only the interface layer and does not contain the tree-code-to-optab decision logic.
